law: Use these examples to create your own indoor map with a style that is consistent with your app’s design.
Use the Indoor Mapping Data Format (IMDF) to show an indoor map with custom overlays and points of interest in your browser.
Use this JavaScript API to embed interactive maps directly into your webpages or apps across different platforms and operating systems, including iOS and Android.
MapKit JS requires authorization through a Maps token for initialization and some API calls.
